# coolify_digitalocean_sizes (Data Source)

Lists DigitalOcean droplet sizes for a cloud provider token. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_digitalocean_sizes" "all" {
  cloud_provider_token_uuid = coolify_cloud_token.do.uuid
}

output "digitalocean_size_slugs" {
  value = [for s in data.coolify_digitalocean_sizes.all.sizes : s.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider_token_uuid` (String) The UUID of the DigitalOcean cloud provider token to use for listing sizes. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `sizes` (Attributes List) The list of DigitalOcean sizes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the size is available.
- `disk` (Number) Disk size in GB.
- `memory` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `price_monthly` (Number) Monthly price in USD.
- `slug` (String) Size slug (e.g. `s-1vcpu-1gb`).
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
